text:
🍉 15S WATERMELON SLICING CHALLENGE  

I asked GPT-6 Astra on @happycapyai to build me a game where you slice a gummy watermelon as many times as possible in 15 seconds. Built entirely with @threejs + WebGPU.  

I dropped the challenge link in the comments. My current best is 19 slices. Let me know your record ⬇️
